title: OpenCastle
tagline: Plugin for an AA account to support session keys that are programable
description:
This project proposes a first implementation of the session key which the user is guaranteed that the dapp can only execute transactions that comply to the policies of the session and until the session expires.
The private key is generated on device by web3Auth and scoped according to the defined functions and time.
how_its_made:
Drastic improvements for non native crypto users in the UX field. Focused in L2, Polygon and developer first integration.
We focus in Polygon because it SCW, transactions will already be more expensive than it being in an L1.
The whole project revolves around empowering devs to give better experiences to users instead of creating another front facing wallet.
